items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Waddell did the arranging, he was paid, all the musicians were paid

ctx.x: And, but what happened, Waddell took it. When Waddell finished with it, it was completely changed. You see, that's one of the, that's one of the beasts that we have as artists. Uh-huh. And everybody around here talked about it. See, you go, you go to an arranger, somebody with a song, the way you feel it, that's the way it is. But when it come back to you, they didn't change it all around. And Waddell completely went away from what we had on this song. Oh, see. Oh, yeah. We had a good thing. And me and Eddie Bo,…
